title: Simosa's conversion to and departure from Christianity
summary: Jason Simosa tells of Simosa's conversion to and departure from Christianity, about age 19 to 25 at England, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um yeah, I mean, I I became a Christian at the age of 19, uh kind of out of nowhere.

plain: Jason Simosa, a researcher from England, says he became a Christian at 19, "kind of out of nowhere," and that he left the faith again by about 25. He mentions someone named Viv Whitten as part of that story, which he tells to explain how his own religious journey shapes his view of the subject.
